Name: Joja Cola Expanded
Author: Objection777
Description:
This mod adds in [b]35+ variants of Joja Cola[/b] into the game, with varied effects, designs, and lore.

Joja Cola variants are obtained from Cola Boxes (fishing and trash) and select vendors.

Variants include but are not limited to the beloved BaJoja Blast, preworkout supplement-esque Joja Cola Jacked, Joja Cola Bean, several energy drinks, and even Joja Cola Hydro (water).

Some of these effects include higher energy restoration, extended speed boosts, some mix of skill and stat boosts, or high boosts to specific stats.

This mod is not meant to be intrusive, but can add a neat surprise to your day.

[b]*12/6/2025 Revisiting mod soon, will update when I get time and energy! Thank you for all of your support and downloads!*[/b]
______________________________________________________________________________________________________

[b][u]Cola Boxes[/u][/b]

Cola Boxes are essentially loot boxes obtained through various means, to include vendors, trash, and fishing. They are opened
by left clicking.

[b][u]Cola Box variants[/u][/b]:

[b]Basic (Blue)[/b]: spawns in colas typically of normal people flavors

[b]Deluxe (Gold)[/b]: spawns in any type of cola, mostly uncommon flavors

[b]Premium (Black)[/b]: spawns in mostly rare, experimental, and unusual flavors

[b]Imported (Pink)[/b]: spawns in mostly weird or promotional flavors
